description: List the users in an organization (Relay connection): each org-user's role, joinedAt, tier, and underlying user (preferredName, email). Paginate with `first` + `after` (pass the last edge's `cursor`). Parabol GraphQL: viewer.organization(orgId).organizationUsers. Requires ORGS_READ + USERS_READ.

after.description: Cursor for the next page (the `cursor` of the last edge from a prior call).

name: list_organization_users
title: List organization users
